title: Where To? (KINO)
synopsis:
In the endless nights of Berlin, a 55 year old Palestinian Uber driver named Hassan shuttles revellers from one party to the next, estranged from his daughter and adrift without purpose. One night a young Israeli tourist exploring his sexuality far from home stumbles into his cab, and months later reappears, now living in Berlin and nursing a broken heart. Across two years of recurring rides, Hassan begins to recognise echoes of his own buried pain, and is finally pushed to confront the past that led him to leave his homeland thirty years ago. Perspectives programme at the 2026 Berlinale.

 

Supported by: Consulate General of Israel in Hong Kong and Macau

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
不夜城柏林歌舞昇平，來自巴勒斯坦的Uber司機大叔哈山遊走各大夜場，與女兒關係疏離的他，晚晚開工難免也會感到人生彷似漫無目的，倍感失落。在尋常不過的一夜，來自以色列的年輕遊客阿米爾踏上哈山的車，在陌生的城市尋找他的性向認同。幾個月後，阿米爾又被哈山接載，已在柏林定居的阿米爾剛承受分手之痛。兩個風馬牛不相及的孤獨靈魂，在兩年間透過一次又一次的車程相遇相知，也讓哈山重新審視自己的過去，回憶三十年前離開家園的往事。2026 柏林影展視角單元選映作品。

 

支持：以色列駐香港及澳門總領事館
